song.title: It's A Happy Day
song.lyrics:
[V1] It's a happy day And I praise God for the weather It's a happy day I'm living it for my Lord
[V2] It's a happy day And things are gonna get better Living each day by the promises of God's word
[C1] Praise God I'm born again! Praise God I'm alive! Praise God I'm born again! And I don't have to sigh
